title: Puppet Master: Choreograph a Parrot-Figure Dance Routine
description: The user acts as a choreographer, sequencing dance moves for a rigged humanoid figure while a parrot mirrors and reacts to each move. Build a 6-step dance routine by selecting moves, adjusting timing and intensity, then play back the synchronized performance with the parrot flying in choreographed patterns around the dancer.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with es-module-shims) that loads Parrot.glb and RiggedFigure.glb via GLTFLoader. Scene setup: a circular wooden-textured stage platform (radius 4), soft ambient light (0x404060), a warm spotlight (0xffe0b0) from above-front targeting the stage center, and a subtle blue rim light from behind. Camera at position (0, 3, 8) looking at (0, 1.5, 0) with OrbitControls limited to prevent going below the floor. Place RiggedFigure at center of stage; place Parrot offset to the right at (2, 2.5, 0). Play any embedded animations from both GLB files using THREE.AnimationMixer for each model. Build a choreography UI panel (HTML/CSS overlay, left side) with these interaction steps requiring parameter validation: Step 1 - Select a dance move from a dropdown of 4 options (Spin, Wave, Bow, Jump) for the figure. Step 2 - Set move duration via a slider (0.5s to 3.0s, validated to be numeric and in range). Step 3 - Set intensity/scale multiplier for the move (0.5x to 2.0x slider, validated). Step 4 - Choose a parrot flight pattern that accompanies the move (Circle, Figure-8, Swoop, Hover) from a dropdown. Step 5 - Set parrot flight radius (1 to 5 units, validated numeric input field). Step 6 - Click 'Add to Routine' button which appends the configured step to a visible routine list (max 6 steps, validate not empty before playback). Step 7 - Click 'Play Routine' to execute all sequenced steps. During playback, animate RiggedFigure by blending between its embedded animation clips scaled by intensity and duration, while the Parrot follows the chosen flight path using sinusoidal/parametric curves around the figure, with its embedded flapping animation timeScale proportional to flight speed. Show a progress bar during playback. Validate that at least 2 routine steps exist before allowing playback. Add a 'Reset' button to clear the routine. Use requestAnimationFrame loop with a delta-time clock. All parameter inputs must show red borders on invalid input with tooltip error messages.
